title: We have proof automation now
summary: Adam Langley discusses using modern proof automation tools to verify a leaner, simplified implementation of the Zstandard (zstd) compression algorithm. The article explores how automated theorem proving has matured to the point where it can handle real-world code verification tasks, making it practical to formally prove correctness of production software.
problem_solved: Making complex software like compression algorithms simpler and provably correct without an overwhelming manual proof burden.
why_valuable: Demonstrates that proof automation has reached practical maturity, enabling developers to formally verify real-world software with reasonable effort, reducing bugs and security vulnerabilities.
